notes.title: Jamestown+ 1.0.5 Patch Notes - December 18, 2019
notes.content:
Hello! Today's 1.0.5 test patch continues to fix some of the issues some players have experienced since launch.

If you're experiencing black-screen issues, try getting your OpenGL version from [url=https://download.cnet.com/OpenGL-Extensions-Viewer/3000-18487_4-34442.html]glView[/url] and sharing your OpenGL support info with us! We've narrowed the issue down to old drivers on old cards - updating your drivers if you're able may resolve the issue. (Also, tell us your operating system - we're interested to hear if you're using something like Boot Camp to run Jamestown+ on a Mac.)

If you use app scaling via Windows (perhaps because you use a 4k monitor), we're looking into how to get our fullscreen borderless window to ignore Windows' scaling settings - in the meantime, if you find JamestownPlus.exe in your install directory, click Properties -> Compatibility -> Change High DPI Settings -> check the Override High DPI box. Your game should look normal in fullscreen - let us know if it doesn't!

This patch also adds additional safeguards intended to prevent some USB devices from confusing the game - we'll continue to improve this in the coming days. Please reach out if this patch breaks support for any input devices you use.

Thanks for playing, and thanks for your continued reports! (Feel free to share bugs on our [url=https://discord.gg/jamestown]Discord server[/url] or on [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/377950/discussions/0/2865909778225580400/]this community thread[/url].)

[b]CHANGES:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed a few issues causing some USB devices to either crash the game or cause the cursor to move in unintended directions.
[*]Fixed an issue causing the "Veni, Vidi, Vici" achievement to unlock by finishing Super Gauntlet on Difficult. (Supposed to be Legendary+.)
[/list]

notes.title: Jamestown+ 1.0.4 Patch Notes - Dec 13, 2019
notes.content:
Hello! We're blown away by the number of you who've already picked up Jamestown+ - thanks for your support! Today's 1.0.4 patch contains a few quick fixes for some of the more common issues we've been seeing post-launch. We'll continue to do these sorts of updates as we fix some of the issues that've popped up!

Note while we're working on it - if JT+ crashes for you on startup, check your connected USB devices, even ones that aren't controllers! One of them may be confusing the game - we're working on a fix.

Thanks for playing, and thanks for your reports so far! (Feel free to share bugs on our [url=https://discord.gg/jamestown]Discord server[/url] or on [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/377950/discussions/0/2865909778225580400/]this community thread[/url].)

[b]CHANGES:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed a crash some users were experiencing relating to their display device (monitor) on game startup.
[*]Fixed a crash that could (apparently!) occur when using Charge vs. the Matriarch.
[*]Fixed an issue causing Steam achievements to only trigger on closing the game.
[*]If you miss the old Jamestown player colors (Red P1), you can add "-red" to the game's startup flags in Steam to make P1 red again.
[/list]
